Team members with “Director” in their role appear first. Use the arrows in Manage entries to order the remaining members.

This editor changes your local preview. It is not a shared admin account and cannot update GitHub directly. Export the updated HTML, then replace index.html in your repository to publish your changes.

GitHub Pages & content guide
  1. Add this file to your GitHub repository as index.html.
  2. In repository Settings → Pages, choose your publishing branch and the folder containing this file.
  3. Use this editor to add real projects, news stories, photos, videos, and team members. Use “Manage entries” to remove examples.
  4. Click Download updated index.html and upload that file to replace the repository copy. Your changes become public after GitHub deploys.
  5. Images up to 3 MB are embedded into the exported HTML. Videos use an HTTPS YouTube link or a hosted MP4/WebM URL. Store larger media separately and paste its public URL.

No passwords, API tokens, or private information belong in this public file. Changes are automatically saved in this browser when storage is available and restored after a refresh of the same published version. Browser data can still be cleared; download your updated HTML as a backup. Export a copy to keep your work.

Upload logo & homepage banner

Square logos work best. A transparent PNG is recommended. The site name stays beside your logo.

A wide image around 2100 × 700 pixels works well. Your banner replaces the original globe and headline. It displays at full width without an overlay or cropping. Each upload must be 3 MB or smaller. Existing embedded images are retained unless replaced or removed.
